description: This file defines a Java class implementing a custom matcher for testing purposes within the Ofbiz framework. It is used to match string values that start with a specified prefix, likely in unit tests to verify behavior of other components.

classes.name: MacroCallParameterStringValueStartsWithMatcher
classes.description: A custom matcher class extending TypeSafeMatcher to determine if an object (expected to be a String) starts with a specific prefix.

methods.name: MacroCallParameterStringValueStartsWithMatcher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matcher with the prefix string to match against.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Checks if the given object is a String that starts with the specified prefix.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Describes the expected condition, indicating what prefix the string should start with.

methods.name: describeMismatchSafely
methods.description: Describes the mismatch when the object does not meet the criteria, showing the actual value.
